headline: Fall Up launches December 3 on consoles and PC
title: Fall Up | Platformer Launch Dec 3 | Gaming News
video_script: Fall Up launches on December third, twenty twenty six for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch 2, PS4, Switch and PC. It is a platformer where you play an electric rabbit robot who bounces around mechanical worlds. Astrolabe Games is the publisher and Unicellular Games is the developer. Would you jump in on day one? Comment below!
description: Fall Up launches December 3, 2026 for PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, PS4, Switch and PC (Steam lists December 2 in some time zones). Sources: Gematsu, Nintendo eShop, PlayStation Store.
joke: A robot rabbit that bounces, and a controller that survives it.
